meta_description: Catalog of concrete staircase types: monolithic, floating, cantilever, and U-shaped solutions for private and commercial objects.
hero_title: Stair Types and Where They Fit
hero_description: Not just a list of shapes. This page helps you quickly understand which configuration matches your opening, budget, and interior style.
story_p_1: The staircase type affects not only appearance, but also comfort, opening requirements, reinforcement scheme, and final budget.
story_p_2: We start from real geometry on site and only then confirm the final configuration. This keeps the project reliable and avoids unnecessary costs.
story_p_3: Below are the key staircase types we work with most often.
catalog_note: For complex and non-standard tasks, we select the type after engineering review.
type_1_desc: Minimal straight flight for direct openings and clean layouts.
type_2_desc: Turn with landing for safer movement and comfortable step rhythm.
type_3_desc: Two flights with a landing for comfortable vertical movement.
type_4_desc: Winder turn when you need to save space in the opening.
type_5_desc: Compact winder turn for narrow openings and tight plans.
type_6_desc: Soft radius and expressive geometry for accent interiors.
type_7_desc: Spiral layout for constrained zones and unusual floor plans.
type_8_desc: Monolithic option for entry groups, terraces, and outdoor steps.
bottom_note: Not sure which type fits your case? Send a plan/photo and we will suggest a practical option.
schema_description: Collection of typical concrete staircase solutions with engineering-first selection logic.
